subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu: send text + multiple images as a single interactive card

question: Should Feishu text/presentation plus image attachments collapse into one interactive image card automatically, or require an explicit Feishu-scoped opt-in?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but the default behavior would change existing Feishu send semantics and the safe image-card limits need owner intent before implementation.

options.title: Opt-in Image Cards
options.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a single card.

options.title: Automatic Image Cards
options.body: Automatically compose one card whenever Feishu sends include text or presentation plus image attachments, with sequential fallback on upload or card failure.

options.title: Wait For Generic Presentation Images
options.body: Defer the Feishu-first path until the cross-channel presentation contract grows a portable image block.

recommendation.title: Opt-in Image Cards
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a single card.

likelyOwner.reason: The package and docs name @m1heng as the Feishu plugin's community owner, and this is a Feishu-specific product behavior choice.
